messages:
Nina (Partnerships): EdgeGrid just dropped a new bundle for the marketplace tile + solution brief. Need quick scan: logo lockup rules, accessibility/alt text, and a short customer line for the tile. Can someone triage?
Raj (Design): On it. Can they provide SVGs + a 1:1 PNG at 1200x1200 and a 16:9 hero at 1200x628? Also asking for transparent and reversed lockups.
EdgeGrid PM: Upload link: https://files.edgegrid.example/marketplace_bundle_v2 (sent to partners drive). Included a suggested quote: "Redwood + EdgeGrid cut inference tail latency by 40% in production."
Lydia Legal: Numeric claims need provenance. Ask for the benchmark doc or a signed attestation from EdgeGrid engineering. Also need explicit written permission for logo use and co-brand placement.
Tom (Marketing): Also confirm alt text for the hero image and a 1-sentence SEO blurb (<= 140 chars). We must include alt text for accessibility and translations.
Raj (Design): Small accessibility note: white logos on light backgrounds fail WCAG contrast. Prefer dark gradient or 20% black overlay on hero. Also recommend alt text pattern: "EdgeGrid & Redwood solution reducing inference latency for video analytics."
Nina (Partnerships): EdgeGrid PM, can you 1) send the benchmark or signed attestation, 2) email confirmation for logo license, and 3) a 140-char blurb? We need those for the marketplace checklist.
EdgeGrid PM: Will ask eng to export the benchmark summary and loop GC for the license email. ETA EOD. Blurb suggestion: "EdgeGrid + Redwood enable faster, cheaper inference for edge workloads."
Raj (Design): Minor file checklist I uploaded to Figma comment: `/specs/edgegrid-exports` - need: `edgegrid_mark_1.svg`, `edgegrid_mark_white.png`, `edgegrid_tile_1200x1200.png`, `edgegrid_hero_1200x628.png`, `edgegrid_onepager_A4.pdf`. Also created a quick mock with alt text examples.
Lydia Legal: If the quote remains numeric, request: (a) data snapshot, (b) timeframe, (c) whether it's internal or customer-facing. If EdgeGrid can't provide, we should use qualitative language like "substantial latency reduction".
assets-bot: Marketplace checklist updated: logos ✅ (pending vector), hero ✅ (pending high-res), quote ⚠️ (needs attestation), alt text ✅, license ⚠️ (pending GC email).
Tom (Marketing): We also need to know if the SI partner (Northstar Integrations) will require their badge/logos on the doc. If yes, we must get their usage permission too. Pinged Northstar.
Nina (Partnerships): Good catch. EdgeGrid, are you working with Northstar on the deployment reference? If so, cc their comms for approvals.
EdgeGrid PM: Yes — Northstar is the SI. I'll cc their comms and legal on the license email.
Raj (Design): Will hold off on final exports until we have licensed assets and confirmed the numeric claim. I can make a draft tile with neutral phrasing to share with Tom.
Nina (Partnerships): Timeline: aim to hand to marketing tomorrow if we have GC email + attestation by 12:00. Otherwise we push to next week. Posting updates here as replies.
